header.description: Manual battery pack assembly: cell loading, laser bus-bar welding, weld-resistance test, label & pack

rows.effects: Wrong pack voltage/capacity; risk of overcharge and thermal event in service
rows.causes: Cells visually similar; no incoming verification at the station
rows.controls: Operator visual check of cell part number before loading
rows.recommended_action: C: Segregate suspect builds; verify lot genealogy. P: Kitting + single-piece flow; separate look-alike cells; scan-to-confirm part number at load. D: Barcode/vision verification interlock that blocks load on mismatch. [8D-2020-031]  Target S8/O2/D2 = 32.

rows.effects: Internal short on connection; potential thermal runaway / fire
rows.causes: Fixture allows cell to seat in the wrong orientation
rows.controls: Keyed (poka-yoke) fixture intended to prevent reversed insertion
rows.recommended_action: C: 100% orientation/polarity check on suspect units. P: Poka-yoke keyed fixture that physically prevents reversed seating. D: Vision/electrical polarity check after load. [LL-2019-005]  Target S9/O1/D4 = 36.

rows.failure_mode: Cell mechanically damaged during loading (dent / scratch / ESD)
rows.effects: Latent internal short; field thermal event
rows.causes: Manual handling; forced insertion; inadequate ESD control
rows.controls: Operator training; handling procedure; ESD precautions
rows.recommended_action: C: Segregate & inspect units from the station; ESD audit. P: Soft/keyed handling fixtures; ESD straps & mats; operator handling certification. D: Post-load visual/dimensional check + continuous ESD event monitor. [CAPA-2021-077]  Target S8/O3/D3 = 72.

rows.controls: Fixture full-nest presence check before weld

rows.failure_mode: Tester accepts a defective weld (false accept / escape)
rows.effects: Defective pack ships; field failure / fire risk
rows.causes: Resistance limits too loose; poor probe contact; calibration drift
rows.controls: Automated resistance test with pass/fail limits; periodic calibration
rows.recommended_action: C: Re-test retained/shipped suspect lots; temporarily tighten accept limits. P: Gauge R&R study; set limits from demonstrated capability; scheduled probe maintenance. D: Periodic calibration + 'test-the-tester' with a known-bad master each shift. [CAPA-2022-103]  Target S9/O3/D3 = 81.

rows.failure_mode: Test step bypassed / pack not tested
rows.causes: Operator bypass; pack not seated in tester; interlock defeated
rows.recommended_action: C: Audit traceability for untested packs; hold & test. P: Hard interlock - next op blocked without a pass record; serial-scan gate. D: MES-enforced routing with bypass alarm + supervisor escalation. [8D-2021-058]  Target S8/O1/D3 = 24.

rows.failure_mode: Tester rejects a good pack (false reject)
Wrong label / incorrect part or serial number
rows.effects: Loss of traceability; wrong product delivered to customer
rows.causes: Label mix-up at printer; manual application error

rows.effects: No traceability; pack cannot be tracked in the field
rows.causes: Printer fault; smear; label not applied
rows.controls: Vision check for label presence and readability

rows.failure_mode: Wrong quantity / mixed product in carton
Insufficient ultrasonic weld bond (low joint strength)
rows.effects: High resistance / open joint; field failure
Loss of thermal path; overheating in service

rows.causes: Oil/moisture on surface; wrong cure profile
